# clovapi

> Local API proxy for model providers.

clovapi stores provider profiles, runs a local HTTP proxy, routes requests by provider id, and transcodes between OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini-compatible API formats.

Useful paths:

- Home: /
- Articles and guides: /blog
- Codex subscription to local API: /blog/codex-subscription-to-local-api
- Local model API proxy guide: /blog/local-model-api-proxy
- Debug local model API calls: /blog/debug-local-model-api-calls
- Agent skill page: /skill
- Agent-readable skill source: /skill.md
- GitHub: https://github.com/joohw/clovapi
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@clovapi/cli

Default proxy:

- http://127.0.0.1:27483
- /{providerId}/v1/...

Primary topics:

- local LLM API proxy
- OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini API format conversion
- Codex and Claude subscription access through localhost
- local request logs, usage inspection, and provider routing
